findings.text: The company was incorporated on 9 February 2022 and is 4.7 years old (1718 days).
The only insolvency case on record is a creditors voluntary liquidation, with the company wound up on 20 March 2026.
Accounts are overdue, with the next accounts due 30 November 2025 and the last accounts made up to 29 February 2024.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 11 November 2025 and is next due 25 November 2026.
There are 2 outstanding charges registered against the company, with none part-satisfied or satisfied.
Since 24 October 2025, PERSON 292 was appointed as director on 7 November 2025 and PERSON 293 resigned as director on the same date.
There is 1 current officer, PERSON 292, and one person with significant control, PERSON 301, who holds 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights.
A registered office address change was filed on 1 April 2026.

headline.text: BEST BUILDERS LTD (91000424) has status 'liquidation' following a creditors voluntary liquidation, wound up on 20 March 2026, and its accounts are overdue.
